title: Toddler A-Z Alphabet Dot Book — Letter Recognition & Fine Motor (195 pages)

overview.description: Massive 195-page alphabet activity book. Each letter gets multiple pages: letter introduction ('A is for...'), then associated words with illustrations (apple, alpaca, etc.). Likely includes dot marker activities (based on 'Dot Book' title) where toddlers use bingo daubers/dot markers to fill in circles on each letter. Covers all 26 letters. Multi-sensory: visual recognition + fine motor (dotting/stamping).

characters: various animals and objects per letter

gaps.name: dot-marker-activity
gaps.description: Pages with large circles for dot marker/bingo dauber stamping. Letters, numbers, or shapes formed by circles that toddlers fill in. Extremely low-skill entry — suitable for 2-year-olds. Needs large, well-spaced circles (at least 1-inch diameter).

notes: At 195 pages, this is substantial. The dot marker format is specifically designed for toddlers — the fine motor demand is minimal (just stamping), making it accessible to very young children. Signals that Aless is thinking about her youngest learner's needs.
